subject.title: Feature: notify sender on WhatsApp after pairing approval

question: Should the WhatsApp pairing approval notification fix add a new plugin SDK/core outbound-message seam, or should maintainers choose a narrower WhatsApp/core-owned implementation for the existing `--notify` contract?
rationale: The user-facing bug is clear, but the closed dedicated PRs show the implementation shape depends on a plugin SDK/core ownership decision and live proof expectations.

options.title: Approve a narrow outbound-notify seam
options.body: Accept a focused SDK/core seam that lets WhatsApp use the shared outbound gateway path for `pairing approve --notify`, then require live redacted delivery proof before merge.

options.title: Require a WhatsApp-local design
options.body: Reject a new SDK mode and ask for a narrower implementation that preserves plugin boundaries while still using gateway-backed WhatsApp delivery.

options.title: Broaden the product behavior
options.body: Treat notification by default or original-message replay as a larger pairing UX feature and design it separately from this bug-level `--notify` gap.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow outbound-notify seam
recommendation.body: Accept a focused SDK/core seam that lets WhatsApp use the shared outbound gateway path for `pairing approve --notify`, then require live redacted delivery proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The main unresolved choice is the plugin SDK/core pairing notification seam, and the current history points most strongly to steipete on those contracts.
